create.name: YOGAJI – Iyengar Yoga Zentrum Köln
create.bio:
YOGAJI is an Iyengar yoga centre in Cologne's inner city, tucked into a courtyard on Moltkestraße. Its name explains its spirit: in Indian usage the suffix "ji" is added to a name as a mark of respect, as in Guruji or Gandhiji, and here it is offered to yoga itself.

Classes are kept small so that teachers can watch each student closely, and they are graded by level, with a first conversation or trial class used to find the right one. Ropes on the wall, blocks, bolsters and blankets support the precise alignment the Iyengar method is known for. The week runs from morning to evening, with general classes for every level, a restorative class, a Sunday morning session, a beginners' class taught in Persian and an evening hour of breathing practice and meditation. Most classes can also be joined live on Zoom, and anyone short of money is invited to ask about a reduced rate.

The centre is led by Afshin Amirsadri, an IT graduate whose spiritual search took him through Sufi meditation and Ashtanga yoga before he trained in Iyengar yoga in Germany and France and became a certified teacher. He teaches alongside Sasan Shaheen, who first met yoga in Mysore in 1995 and completed an Iyengar training in Cologne between 2013 and 2016.

courses.title: Iyengar yoga classes in Cologne and online
courses.description: Small-group Iyengar classes from Level 1 to Level 3, plus all-level, restorative and Sunday sessions and a weekly breathing and meditation class. Most classes are also streamed on Zoom; booking ahead is required.
